description: A queue emptied by TTL expiry sends the MAC back to SENSE, from LBT_WAIT and from CONT_WAIT.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ. At 0 it sends "gone" with TTL 1 (TTD 2000): dts.ttd starts at 2000 (C-1050) and the MAC goes to LBT_WAIT with 30000 (K-0070). At 2000 the TTD passes and the C_PDU is dropped (C-0857, C-0864); the queue is empty, so the MAC cancels csma.lbt_wait and returns to SENSE (K-0078). At 3000 it sends "gone" again with TTL 20 (TTD 43000): dts.ttd starts for 40000 ms; the channel has been idle since time 0 by DCD, so LBT_WAIT starts with 30000. At 33000 the LBT timer expires and seed 0 draws slot 15, 45000 ms (K-0080). At 43000 the TTD passes in CONT_WAIT: the C_PDU is dropped, and the empty queue cancels csma.cont_wait and returns the MAC to SENSE (K-0091).
